activity_summary: You placed George two paces inside the pillars for the Worthies, and Heminges let you go at ten minutes to eleven so you could reach Paul's. You asked him to keep Sam out of the east wind. George asked you not to bring another Latin tag back from the churchyard. You said you would bring only English, and none of it for his roll.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Placed George, asked that Sam be kept out of the wind, and left at 10:50.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Set Tom's entrance and released you ten minutes early.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Named the crush in the arras if Pompey does not clear.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Asked where he stands, and asked for no more Latin.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Mentioned. He was behind the tire-house door, out of the wind.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
